title: Other Worlds: Using AI to Revisit Cybersyn and Rethink Economic Futures
reasoning: The paper explores how Large Language Models represent and potentially dilute alternative political and economic 'value-systems' (specifically socialist ideals) in favor of neoliberal orthodoxy. This analysis of how AI models handle competing societal values and ideological frameworks constitutes an evaluation of the models' inherent ethical and value-based biases.
